question: Should Crabbox adopt this read-only device-pairing credential flow as the approved server-side foundation for the first-party mobile companion discussed in https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/778?
rationale: The patch is intentionally narrow and has concrete runtime proof, but the linked canonical issue reserves the mobile scope and credential/session security model for maintainer choice; code review cannot safely make that product and ownership decision.

options.title: Sponsor the read-only coordinator slice
options.body: Accept device pairing as the approved portal/coordinator-oriented v1 foundation and assign review ownership for token lifecycle, origin policy, and operational support.

options.title: Defer pending the mobile roadmap decision
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until the canonical issue records the accepted mobile scope and security owner.

options.title: Choose a different mobile security model
options.body: Decline this credential contract and document the replacement model in the canonical roadmap before requesting a revised implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the read-only coordinator slice
recommendation.body: Accept device pairing as the approved portal/coordinator-oriented v1 foundation and assign review ownership for token lifecycle, origin policy, and operational support.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the concrete server-side proposal and can answer implementation and threat-model questions while a maintainer decides the product direction.
